funFacts: Caffeine kicks in after about 20 minutes and peaks at 45 minutes.
The half-life of caffeine is 5–6 hours.
Finland has the highest per-capita coffee consumption in the world: ~12 kg/year!
The lethal dose of caffeine is ~10g – that's about 100 cups of coffee.
Caffeine blocks adenosine receptors – that's why you crash when it wears off.
It takes about 3–5 days for your body to reset caffeine tolerance.
Espresso has MORE caffeine per ml, but LESS per serving than filter coffee.
Pregnant women are advised to limit caffeine to 200 mg per day.
